reason: I don't trust an AI with my money, and I'm not signing up for another monthly subscription with no price on it just to have a cartoon pet move my index funds around. I already buy my ETFs monthly in my broker app for free.
objection: Letting an AI invest and pay for me with real money, even with limits, through a broker partner that isn't even named yet. If it screws up, it's my small account that takes the hit.
would_change_my_mind: A long public track record on real money with a named, licensed broker, plus a flat price of a couple of dollars a month or less, cheaper than what I'd pay a robo-advisor on my balance.
